name: Suzuki Boulevard C50
engine: 805 cc liquid-cooled V-twin, fuel injected, shaft drive
intro: A common mid-size Suzuki cruiser. Check the 2005-2006 ignition switch recall and the charging system.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. 2005 and 2006 C50s were recalled for the ignition switch, and Suzuki said not to ride them until it was replaced.
A-002.reason: A failing ignition switch can shut the engine off while riding.

F: A battery that keeps dying often points to a failing regulator/rectifier or loose battery leads. Test charging voltage at idle and 5,000 rpm.

recallNote: No recalls found for these years when this course was written. Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls to be sure.

known.title: Charging
known.what: Stator and regulator/rectifier failures cause dim lights and dead batteries.
